task.description: Implement ADP-12 per src/design/adp-12-default-tenant-regression-suite.md by adding deterministic default-tenant regression coverage that runs Stage 1-6 endpoint checks pre- and post-adaptation-migration boundary and enforces zero-diff response invariants under the canonicalization rules in design. Produce stable report artifacts for automated comparison, wire the suite into existing test/build workflow, and keep all changes additive and backward-compatible. Execute required backend validations (build, test, migrate) before completion.
acceptance_criteria: ADP-12 regression suite runs against default tenant in pre/post migration phases
Comparison logic enforces zero diffs for status/body/headers excluding explicitly allowed informational fields
Outputs include deterministic machine-readable comparison report artifacts
zig build, zig build test, and zig build migrate pass
No behavioral regressions introduced for existing Stage 1-6 flows

result.summary: Implemented ADP-12 deterministic default-tenant regression harness with pre/post migration-phase orchestration, canonical response comparison (status/headers/body with informational allowlist exclusions), stable machine-readable artifact output, and build target wiring via zig build test-adp12-regression.
